{{Infobox NPC | image = Celebratory Kukulkan.jpg | name = Celebratory Kukulkan | race = Not Specified | bestiary = Peiste | affiliation = Seasonal Event }} ==Locations== [[Konschtat Highlands]] (roaming) ==Seasonal Events== *[[Happy New Year 2013]], [[Happy New Year 2025|2025]] ==Interactions and Dialogue== Followed by a host of 3 [[Celebratory Kukulkan|Jubilant Peiste]]s. Trading gifts to the Kukulkan grants players either doses of [[Peiste Concoction]] or holiday items and random, short duration buffs. The Celebratory Kukulkan will occasionally Petrify players for 15~30 seconds instead of giving an item. Alternative New Year Lucky Beasts patrol other areas (the [[Fortuitous Leviathan]]) and [[Valkurm Dunes]] (the [[Gleeful Gukumatz]]) during the same holiday period. *When giving items: (The blessings of the New Year upon thee... The world is ever changing, with each instant different than the one before. Yet the skies tell me that things will continue looking up!) *When not giving items: (Tohoho, that look in your eyes could pierce through the souls of a thousand wandering spirits, That's well and good, but...where are we?) *When petrifying players: (Yearling tidings to ye... I sense that the world is in a state of flux. The clouds in the sky do not bode well...)
(Kukulkan's Fang is all you can think of? I shall let you have time to reflect upon youself and your deeds.)

| notes =  '''Offers General Information:'''
:Perhaps I could be of service. Is there anything in particular you'd like to know?
:*"''Nothing Actually.''"
:*"''I'd like to get out of the city.''": Just got here and you're aching to leave, eh? Listen, the lands are wild beyond our gates, filled with fiends and their ilk. Right behind you is the Westgate. Beyond that, the wilds of West Ronfaure. Should you need directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.
:*"''I'd like to do some shopping.''": Should you seek weapons, armor, or supplies, there are several shops in this area. Why not go have a look?
:*"''Tell me more about adventuring.''": Ahhh, recruits... Don't know which way to hold a sword and you think you're ready for adventures. Well, what would you like to know?
::*"''Helping people.''": Ah, a commendable choice! Come to think of it, there was a lady in front of a house on Pikeman's Way. She may be in need of assistance. Should you need directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.
::*"''Hunting monsters.''": Novices... Don't know your own limits until a fiend beats it into your head for you. Very well. How about gathering some hides for the Tanners' Guild on Pikeman's Way? Should you need directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.
::*"''Making easy money.''": Easy money, eh? Typical of a new recruit. I cannot promise ease, but the lumberyard in Northern San d'Oria should have work for you there. To get to the lumberyard, go through Victory Arch, head northwest across the Parade Grounds, and keep going till you reach Laborman's Way. The lumberyard lies at the far end. Should you need directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.
::*"''Working for my country.''": Ah, a commendable choice. Head to any city gate and inquire at the gatehouse. They'll be doing work for the glory of the kingdom! Should you need directions, ask those around you. Our citizens are friendly, for the most part.

You may call Alter Egos. You have 15 minutes to win. *You are assisted by [[Magh Bihu]], [[Dazbog]] and the [[Gloom Phantom]]. If any of them fall the battlefield ends in failure. *Chaos has approximately 180k HP in this battlefield.[https://youtu.be/65SqraGpZGU NextGames, YouTube] Chaos uses a variety of AOE attacks throughout the fight. Chaos can be stunned and silenced. *Chaos casts tier IV -ga Elemental nukes and [[Meteor]]. *Casts Cure VI to restore anywhere from 29k to 32k HP. *[[Overrun]] *[[Landfall]] - AOE Damage. Knocks players back. *[[Wing Buffer]] - AOE Damage. Inflicts silence. *[[Swooping Assault]] *[[Wrenching Impale]] - Its lone single target attack. *[[Seeping Dread]] - AOE Terror. *[[Tenebrous Surge]] - AOE magic damage. ==The Voracious Beast== *Your opponent in the final part of the dual battlefields for [[The Voracious Beast]]. You may summon Alter Egos even if engaged in combat, but a full party of adventurers is strongly advised. You have 30 minutes to win. *Chaos has ~200k HP in this fight, but restores to full HP for phase 2 so you will have to chew through ~380K worth of HP plus whatever Cure VI restores to it.[https://youtu.be/oKoLPRw0kCw NextGames, YouTube] *You are assisted by a series of NPC helpers throughout the fight. They will fall to Chaos's attacks over time, but reinforcements periodically arrive. The NPC helpers show up in this order: *[[Medada]] and [[Gurebu-Ogurebu]]. *[[Cornelia (Mythril Musketeer)|Cornelia]], the monk from The Shadow Lord's storyline. *[[Ragelise]], a paladin. *[[Lehko Habhoka]], a caster who attacks from range. *[[Fickblix]], a goblin red mage. *[[Luzaf]], the Ephramadian rebel. ===Abilities=== *Casts a variety of high level black elemental -ga magic. Also has access to high level [[Blue Magic]] like [[Blinding Fulgor]], [[Scouring Spate]] and [[Mighty Guard]]. Can cast [[Meteor]] and [[Cure VI]] for tens of thousands of HP. Chaos can be silenced and stunned. All of Chaos's abilities hit in an area of effect *[[Overrun]] *[[Landfall]] - AOE Damage. Knocks players back. *[[Wing Buffer]] - AOE Damage. Inflicts silence. *[[Swooping Assault]] *[[Wrenching Impale]] *[[Seeping Dread]] - AOE Terror. *'''[[Oppressive Yawp]]''' - a very wide area of effect dispel. Removes everything but reraise, Afterglow and signet-like effects. *[[Luminous Surge]] *[[Tenebrous Surge]] *[[Pellucid Surge]] Once Chaos has been brought down to below ~25% once, its HP bar becomes shrouded, it will heal to full via [[Sanative Shadow]] and it gains access to: *'''[[Black Sanctus]]''' Instantly KOs any active NPC helpers. Summons a [[Profane Circle]] for each helper that falls. '''As long as a fetter is active, Chaos takes 99% less damage from all sources. Fetters are very susceptible to skillchain damage.''' Fetters have approximately 90K HP. *During this final stage of the fight, Chaos may only be defeated by a final blow from [[Prime Weapons]]. ==References==
